technical_gate.note: R5 solved the black gaps, bead chain, pointed impact and card-edge issues, but the resulting untextured soft-lobe hierarchy remains below the commercial VFX floor.

visual_findings: Muzzle is readable and warm but remains a broad defocused glow with weak internal flame structure.
Flight is now body-contacting and continuous, but it is built from several large blurred orange circles. It reads as a fused puff train rather than a shaped high-temperature plume.
The yellow center is another soft blob and does not create the crisp tapered white-hot pressure path visible in the user's school-quality fire reference.
Impact is broad and rounded with no star or ring, but it remains a single soft orange mass containing two red pill-like folds; the event lacks a structured contact core and turbulent flame edges.
The two terminal embers are restrained, yet they cannot compensate for the low-frequency, textureless main masses.
R5 is technically cleaner than R4 but is still below the commercial VFX floor, so expensive lifecycle cycles are correctly withheld.

r6_visual_contract.body_freeze: Preserve the approved normalized FBX bytes/hash, 83 renderers, 34500-triangle disclosed import result, eight remaps, all body GUIDs, transforms and R4-frozen body material values.
r6_visual_contract.texture_source_rule: Do not generate another low-resolution radial/blob texture and do not use AI imagery. Reuse a read-only artist-authored or already-approved transparent flame-mask family already in Assets/SW, cloned only into item-local StrictCustomDerived materials. The existing `Sol4Repair1/VFX_Flame_HotCore_Repair1.mat` and its `Sol4_FlameLobeMask_Repair1_512x128.asset` are authorized candidates for a proof because they provide a tapered structured alpha mask. Source assets remain unmodified.
r6_visual_contract.muzzle: Retain the current compact envelope but replace the featureless hot center with one or two tapered structured flame-mask cores, offset and overlapped inside a softer orange pressure shoulder. No opaque card, ring, radial spoke, needle or white clipping.
r6_visual_contract.flight: Keep body contact and the 0.75 to 0.95 body-length envelope. Replace the fused circular puff train with three to five overlapping unequal tapered flame-mask lobes whose visible alpha shapes interlock into one continuous plume. Use a clear white-yellow tapered center, orange shoulder and dark-red outer fold. Keep only two terminal embers. No black gaps, equal beads, smoke wall or detached tongue.
r6_visual_contract.impact: Build a compact asymmetric thermal contact event from three or four unequal rotated tapered flame-mask lobes around one displaced crisp hot core, with one soft low-alpha outer fold. It must have structured turbulent edges and internal value hierarchy while remaining rounded overall. No pills, kite, star, ring, spokes, beam or screen-filling cloud.
r6_visual_contract.proof_gate: Before any 30-cycle run, provide original 1024x768 M/F/I timing, black and neutral-gray single-renderer proofs for every distinct material/texture role, body visibility proof and unchanged benchmark comparison.
r6_visual_contract.fallback: If the authorized existing flame-mask family cannot produce a clean transparent structured result without card edges, stop and report the limitation; do not fall back to more radial blobs or opaque geometry.
